product: Shift dates in Lakeflow Jobs parameters with date arithmetic (Beta)
tagline: Dynamic value references in Lakeflow Jobs can now shift a date by a duration before formatting it.
what_it_does: Dynamic value references in Lakeflow Jobs can now shift a date by a duration before formatting it. For example, {{(job.start time 1.day).iso date}} passes the date of the day before the run started to a task. Date arithmetic is in Beta.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Dynamic value references in Lakeflow Jobs can now shift a date by a duration before formatting it. For example, {{(job.start time 1.day).iso date}} passes the date of the day before the run started to a task.
key_takeaway: Dynamic value references in Lakeflow Jobs can now shift a date by a duration before formatting it.
